description: Vault extended info is write-once: a PATCH on existing extended info fails with HTTP 412 and an empty body, which surfaced as a retried UnknownAzureError. Add the optional If-Match header member and type the 412 as VaultExtendedInfoAlreadySet (shape added by VaultExtendedInfoCreateOrUpdate.json).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Etag of the current extended info (from a GET); "*" matches any version.
